notes.title: Paper Bride 4 is available now! Buy bundle to get more discounts!
notes.notes:
Paper Bride 4 Bound Love steam version is available globally now, with a 10% discount for the first week!

At the same time, there will also be a special offer for the Paper Bride tetralogy bundle.

Pray to the matchmaker for a good marriage.
Breathing jade waves in the wind,rising with lingering sentiments.
Love is entwined like a red thread, hard to untie...

Long time no see,are you still the same as before?
Dreams and reality are as one. Who is a ghost, and who is not? Are you still you?

Welcome everyone to return to the world of Paper Bride. This time, let us uncover the secrets of Yichang Town together.

While exploring the secrets of Yichang Town through immersive puzzle solving,we have also prepared exciting benefits for everyone!
Share and comment on this post, we will randomly select 2 friends on May 5 to get a Paper Bride 4 steam key!

notes.title: "Paper Bride 4 " &"Eastern Games Fest 2023" game exhibition event is ongoing
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce that our "Paper Bride 4 Bound Love" is participating in the "Eastern Games Fest 2023" event hosted by the steam platform!
During the "Eastern Games Fest 2023" event, "Paper Bride 4 Bound Love" will be displayed in the "Eastern Charm" exhibition area.
Welcome to add "Paper Bride 4 Bound Love" to your wishlist and stay tuned!

The game will be released at 10 o'clock on April 28, 2023（UTC+8）~ Thank you for your support and love for the Paper Bride series! 

"Paper Bride 4 Bound Love" looks forward to meeting everyone at the "Eastern Games Fest 2023" event.

"Eastern Games Fest 2023" game exhibition event:
https://store.steamchina.com/sale/easterngamesfest
